scope: Event-selected regional official/reliable public news, 2023-2024; retrospective sensitivity, no unseen holdout
availability: publication plus one day, an assumption; historical body/headline vintage is not verified
strict_vintage_mode: exclude all new captured sources until historical vintages established
cohort: all IDs complete in 2023, no 2024 completeness filter
unknown: NaN event counts when no selected evidence; source coverage unknown everywhere. No count zero asserted from non-observation.
report: all common scored pairs, every month, early and late; no arm selection or primary model replacement
limitations: many publication records refer to the same episode
regional context is not municipality exposure
